newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank says it no takeover target.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank says it no takeover target.

text.p: Germany's Commerzbank AG on Friday reiterated that it did not see itself as a potential takeover target.
Chief executive Martin Kohlhaussen said in the text of a speech prepared for the annual shareholders' meeting that he was convinced Commerzbank would remain independent.

He noted that the bank's market value had more than trebled in the last four years to 20 billion marks and that Commerzbank's share price had jumped by more than 50 percent in the last year to more than 50 marks.
Commerzbank's share price rise has been partly caused by market speculation that it may be taken over by a foreign bank. Analysts have called such a move unlikely.
